from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, textwrap
root=Path.cwd()
task=root/"reports/T0006"
freeze=json.loads((task/"review-r3-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
prior=json.loads((task/"review-r2-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
docs=["README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md","reports/T0006/review-r3/review.md"]
for p,h in freeze["input_sha256"].items():
    if p not in docs: assert sha(p)==h,("input changed",p)
history=prior["history_sha256"]|freeze["history_sha256"]
for p,h in history.items(): assert sha(p)==h,("history changed",p)
print(f"PASS: product/test/unrelated inputs frozen; {len(history)} historical files unchanged")
check=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(check.stdout,end="")
print(check.stderr,end="")
assert check.returncode==0
links=0
blocks=0
for name in docs:
    p=Path(name)
    source=p.read_text()
    assert source.endswith("\n") and all(line==line.rstrip() for line in source.splitlines()),name
    assert "accepted" in source,name
    for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",source):
        target=target.strip("<>").split("#",1)[0]
        if target and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+:",target):
            assert (p.parent/target).exists(),(name,target)
            links+=1
    for i,code in enumerate(re.findall(chr(96)*3+r"python\n(.*?)"+chr(96)*3,source,re.S)):
        compile(textwrap.dedent(code),f"{name}:{i}","exec")
        blocks+=1
handoff=Path(docs[2]).read_text()
assert "- 状态："+chr(96)+"accepted"+chr(96) in handoff
for i in range(1,8): assert f"- [x] A{i}：" in handoff
runs={}
for name in ("review-r3-freeze","review-r3-probes","review-r3-focused"):
    d=task/name
    rec=json.loads((d/"record.json").read_text())
    assert rec["status"]=="finished" and rec["exit_code"]==0,name
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]==rec["after"]["source_sha256"],name
    for key in ("stdout","stderr"): assert sha(d/(key+".txt"))==rec[key+"_sha256"],name
    runs[name]={k:rec[k] for k in ("argv","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")}
assert "101 passed in 0.23s" in (task/"review-r3-focused/stdout.txt").read_text()
assert not (task/"review-r3-focused/stderr.txt").read_bytes()
artifacts=docs+["reports/T0006/review-r3/probe.py","reports/T0006/review-r3-probes/findings.json","reports/T0006/review-r3-freeze/audit.json"]
audit={
 "created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "result":"PASS","task_status":"accepted",
 "head":freeze["head"],"reviewer":"Codex + gpt-6-astra xhigh",
 "independent_static_reviewer":"/root/review_t0006_tests",
 "accepted_files":{p:sha(p) for p in ("src/kmesh/logic/proof.py","tests/test_proof.py")},
 "product_defect_found":False,"open_findings":[],
 "closed_findings":["R1 isolation (previous round)","R2 discriminating missing-reference fixture","R3 huge positive reference reaches range check","R4 appended record corrections"],
 "acceptance":{f"A{i}":"PASS" for i in range(1,8)},
 "A7_limits":"Evidence sufficient to accept current results; unrecorded /tmp precheck, self-reported link-check failure and first-round historical limitations remain. This is not a claim of complete procedural compliance.",
 "verification_runs":runs,
 "independent_tests_this_round":"101 passed in 0.23s; no skips/xfails",
 "pi_full_run_verified":"438 passed in 4.05s; all five Pi R3 RUN logs and before/after hashes verified",
 "full_suite_repeated_by_codex_this_round":False,
 "full_suite_scope_reason":"Only two proof test bodies and one docstring changed; product, original 337 tests and other proof tests unchanged. Focused independent run plus targeted mutants and Pi full evidence are sufficient.",
 "mutation_probe":json.loads((task/"review-r3-probes/findings.json").read_text()),
 "history_files_verified":len(history),"history_scope":"Union of previous 721-file freeze and current freeze; preserves older tasks' review-r3 reports as well.",
 "hygiene":{"git_diff_check":"PASS","local_links_checked":links,"python_blocks_compiled":blocks,"text":"PASS"},
 "artifact_sha256":{p:sha(p) for p in artifacts},
 "limits":["No source/test modification during review","Given finite proof validation only; no proof generation/enumeration/world audit","False is not a negative query label; resource limit is not False","No commit or push"]
}
with (task/"review-r3/final-audit.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(audit,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print(f"PASS: diff, accepted status, {links} links, {blocks} Python blocks")
print("PASS: final-audit.json written; accepted product 008bdd36..., tests 68fef57a...")
